title: HtmlAside
responsibility: Renders the native aside element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlAside.attributes
inputs.description: Native aside attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlAside.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native aside element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlAside
outputs.description: The actual native aside element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
